desk-a-moves.en: The student moves to the class Biology 11 — Teacher B.
desk-a-moves.ar: ينتقل الطالب إلى فصل ⁨Biology 11 — Teacher B⁩.

desk-b-no-class.en: Teacher C has no class of this subject yet: the student stays in Biology 11 — Teacher A and waits to be placed.
desk-b-no-class.ar: ليس لدى ⁨Teacher C⁩ فصل في هذه المادة بعد: يبقى الطالب في ⁨Biology 11 — Teacher A⁩ وينتظر توزيعه.

desk-c-refused-clash.en: The move was refused: the student stays in Biology 11 — Teacher A. It would clash in the published timetable: Student FU-5 would be in Biology 11 — Teacher B and Homeroom 11 — Teacher H at Wednesday period 2 from Wednesday, 21 October 2026 (Term 1 — first)
desk-c-refused-clash.ar: رُفض النقل: يبقى الطالب في ⁨Biology 11 — Teacher A⁩. سيتعارض في الجدول المنشور: ⁨Student FU-5⁩ سيكون في ⁨Biology 11⁩ — ⁨Teacher B⁩ و⁨Homeroom 11⁩ — ⁨Teacher H⁩ يوم الأربعاء في الحصة 2 بدءًا من الأربعاء, 21 أكتوبر 2026 (⁨Term 1⁩ — ⁨first⁩)

desk-d-whole-class.en: The whole class Biology 11 — Teacher D goes to Teacher C: the student stays in it.
desk-d-whole-class.ar: ينتقل فصل ⁨Biology 11 — Teacher D⁩ كله إلى ⁨Teacher C⁩: ويبقى الطالب فيه.

desk-e-self-study.en: The student leaves the class Biology 11 — Teacher A after today: self-study from now.
desk-e-self-study.ar: يغادر الطالب فصل ⁨Biology 11 — Teacher A⁩ بعد اليوم: دراسة ذاتية من الآن.
